df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
a = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP'].copy()
anom_date='2025-10-13'

    ga = an.groupby(col).unblended_cost.sum()
    comp = pd.concat([gb.rename('base'), ga.rename('anom')], axis=1).fillna(0)
    comp['delta']=comp.anom-comp.base
    comp=comp[comp.delta.abs()>0.01].sort_values('delta', ascending=False)
    print("\n===",col,"===")
    print(comp.round(2))
